title: liriope minor var. angustissima
intro: Liriope minor var. angustissima, commonly known as Dwarf Liriope or Dwarf Blue Lilyturf, is a type of flowering plant in the lilyturf family (Liliaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that can help to soothe and calm the body and mind. The therapeutic actions of Liriope minor var. angustissima include reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and modulating the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
